answers.M6-S1: Good friends share special things with you, so you should be nice to people even if you didn't like them before.
answers.M6-S2: Because the magic seed won't work if you tell anyone. That's one of the rules, like walking backward.
answers.M6-S3: The narrator thinks Billy is being really generous by sharing the seed, and the reader knows the seed just needs more time to work because it's only been three days.
answers.M6-S4: He was worried he'd be short like Uncle Alec, and he really wanted to be taller, so the seed seemed perfect.
answers.M6-S5: Because Peg Bowen is a witch and going to her was scary and awful, so he doesn't want to go back.
answers.M6-S6: It shows the seed hasn't made him grow yet, but it will soon since he's only taken it for three days.
answers.M6-S7: To show that the magic seed really works, because Billy used to be a runt and got tall from taking it.
answers.M6-S8: Billy wasn't very popular, but he's actually nice, so the narrator decides to like him more from now on.
answers.M6-S9: He likes his uncle a lot, but he doesn't want to be short like him. He wants to be taller.
